goal.objective: Execute one bounded local source-generation attempt from admitted owner work using only explicitly activated source-generation and sovereign-local-model capabilities, persist proof/teardown, and emit a strict local generation result for the existing AE binder.
success_predicates: Dual explicit ACTIVATED capability evidence is present
Canonical local runtime and exact owner source are locally materialized
Only loopback bounded inference is used
Generated files are restricted to admitted paths with mirror handoff first
Measured usage and teardown evidence are persisted
No GitHub/provider/wallet/non-TV/TVC secret or token enters execution
stegverse.local-source-generation-result/v0.1 is emitted for the existing binder
failure_predicates: Either capability is below ACTIVATED or proof is missing
Local runtime is unavailable or non-private
Structured output is invalid or exceeds admitted scope
Model output is treated as authority

task.derivation_reason: Separately authorized execution lane required because source generation is not authority inherited from the binder or model availability.

activation.recheck_trigger: each control-plane observation while admitted owner work lacks a valid local generation result

completion.next_authorized_action: Observe exact dual activation evidence, materialized owner/runtime roots and a valid structured local-model profile; execute one bounded loopback generation and emit its result.
terminal_when: Every actionable admitted owner delta has a validated local generation result or a machine-observable fail-closed blocker
Executor receipt and teardown evidence are emitted
